geometry.model: Kerr-Newman null geodesics; all thin-plunge intersections then first opaque outer disk
geometry.charge_definition: q=Q/(M sqrt(4 pi epsilon_0 G)); geometrized Q/M
geometry.disk_matter: neutral test matter; no Lorentz force or plasma response
geometry.spin_alignment: black-hole angular momentum and disk angular momentum both +z; prograde
geometry.integrator: double-precision RK4; Hermite equatorial root followed by partial RK4 event step
geometry.camera_angle_convention: signed degrees about disk x axis; n=(0,-sin(theta),cos(theta))
geometry.camera_screen_basis: e_x=(1,0,0); e_y=(0,cos(theta),sin(theta)); continuous through both poles
geometry.disk_plane_crossing: observer-at-infinity crossing excluded; coplanar rays first enter outer rim
geometry.delay_definition: elapsed coordinate propagation time minus one common observer Kerr-Newman r*; q-r*(hit)
geometry.azimuth: pole-regular angular vector plus backward Kerr-Newman radial frame-dragging integral
geometry.disk_surfaces: same prescribed isotropic surface emission on both faces
geometry.capture_cutoff_safety: cutoff strictly below prograde equatorial photon orbit; no exterior escaping radial turn is discarded
geometry.storage_limit_policy: unresolved overflow raises; test convergence by increasing capacity
geometry.image_order: number of finite equatorial crossings before the emitting event; no artificial bands
geometry.event_order: near to far along a backward ray
geometry.disk_opacity: outer disk opaque; inner plunging sheet transfer prescribed separately
geometry.photon_radial_momentum: future-directed covariant k_r/E = sign(backward du/ds) sqrt(R)/Delta

flow.frequency_shift: g=1/[u^t-lambda*u^phi-(k_r/E)*u^r]; forward covariant photon k_r retained with its radial sign

emission.perturbation: positive, analytically mean-normalized localized angular packets on several radial scales, plus a coherent m2 logarithmic spiral; no axisymmetric rings
emission.angular_kernel: K_n(theta)=(1+cos(theta))^n/[binomial(2n,n)/2^n]; positive, unit mean, finite degree n
emission.kernel_blending: convex mixtures of degrees1,2,4,8,12; broad packets capped at4; highest active angular degree follows a birth-parcel angular-advection cadence guide
emission.sampling_bandwidth: 0.99*pi/[1.02*max_future_abs(Omega)*dt_frame]; nine characteristic times per50t_g parcel lifetime; 240 unique frames/cycle; smooth positive-kernel blending, gas frequencies unchanged
emission.sampling_limit: angular guide only, not a bound on every temporal frequency; radial transport, birth crossfades, retardation and changing viewpoint require separate temporal convergence checks
emission.normalization: M=(1+C*sum_j w_j*K_j)/(1+C*sum_j w_j), with nonnegative radial weights and unit-mean positive kernels; current/previous fields crossfade convexly
emission.advection: r_birth=age^-1(age(r)-birth_age); backward along the same normalized outer drift and neutral geodesic plunge used in photon frequency shifts
emission.coherence_choice: phenomenological finite lifetime, about a few bright inner orbits; not a calculated MRI correlation time
emission.birth_blending: current and previous births, complementary sin^2/cos^2 windows; continuous first time derivative
emission.periodicity: seeded field births repeat every loop_period_tg; gas orbital frequencies are not quantized
emission.emission_time_rule: t_em=t_obs-delay_tg separately at each photon/source event
emission.azimuthal_mean: exactly background profile at fixed radius and emitted time, since every perturbation has integer m>=1
emission.plunge_emissivity: separate prescribed weak heating: plunge_peak_fraction*(1-x)^2, x=(r-rplus)/(rISCO-rplus); zero value/slope at ISCO, finite exterior limit at horizon; no source on/inside horizon
emission.horizon: no source on or inside rplus; no boundary glow; g^4, photon delays and capture applied by renderer
emission.surface_emission: identical isotropic thin equatorial source on both sides; optical-depth handling specified by tracer
emission.dimensional_normalization: none; mass, accretion rate, temperature and spectrum unspecified
illustrative_prescriptions: finite-lived multiscale emissivity packets and a logarithmic spiral

radiative_transfer.horizon: no source or surface on or inside r_plus; captured rays can see foreground gas

sampling.refinement_selection: spherical-null critical curve sampling band plus every higher-order or plunging-gas parent pixel
sampling.refinement: independently traced subpixel null geodesics; equal-area average in radiance; no painted rings
sampling.overflow: sparse retrace with16eventslots and half RK4 step; unresolved rays raise
sampling.shutter: 180-degree source-only exposure,3pointGauss quadrature; fixed central-view photon geometry

geodesic_reuse: 120independent central views; exact antipodal geometry with new source evaluation at phi+pi and own retardedtime
time: 800t_g per8-second constructed source/camera loop, four identical encoded repeats

encoding.rate_control: quality-targeted VBR with a VBV cap; CRF is not a platform requirement
encoding.color_conversion: sRGB RGB to Rec.709 limited-range YCbCr via zscale; pixels transformed before tagging
encoding.conversion_reference: display-referred: sRGB EOTF to linear light, then inverse BT.1886 (gamma 2.4) for Rec.709 display encoding
